seo.description: Convert annual or monthly salary to hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly equivalents with Zetawala’s free calculator. Enter working days, hours per day, and weeks per year—deterministic math, no AI.

faqs.q: How is salary converted to an hourly rate?
faqs.a: Annual salary (monthly × 12 if needed) ÷ (Weeks per year × Days per week × Hours per day) = Hourly rate. Daily, weekly, and monthly figures follow from that calendar.

faqs.q: Should freelancers use this as a billable rate?
faqs.a: Employee-equivalent hourly is a starting point only. Freelancers usually need a higher billable rate to cover taxes, benefits, and non-billable time—use the Freelance Hourly Rate Calculator next.

faqs.q: Does this salary calculator use AI?
faqs.a: No. Conversions are pure arithmetic from the salary and schedule you enter.

faqs.q: What weeks-per-year value should I use?
faqs.a: 52 assumes no unpaid time off. Some people use ~48–50 to reflect vacation; lowering weeks raises the implied hourly rate.

faqs.q: Who should use a salary to hourly calculator?
faqs.a: Job seekers comparing offers, HR teams explaining pay, and freelancers translating W-2 salaries into contractor rate discussions.

faqs.q: Can I start from a monthly salary?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose the monthly period; the tool annualizes (×12) before computing hourly, daily, and weekly equivalents.
